_method: GET vs POST on the SAME path, plus one controlled TableId variation
_lark_msg: Invalid parameter type in param: TableId. Invalid parameter value: "<the id GET just accepted>". Please check and modify accordingly.
_verdict: SERVER-SIDE DRIFT on the POST verb — the library's request is not the variable
_note: LD-329 spike leg 2, the discriminator. Three raw-HTTP calls through the library's OWN transport core (tests-only CredentialedRawHttpClient subclass, the LD-264/schema-gate precedent) so lark-oapi's serialization is out of the picture. (a) GET on the exact failing path with the exact table_id answers code:0 and lists the 4 default columns — the gateway accepts this TableId on this path. (b) POST on that same path with the DOCUMENTED minimal body {field_name, type} answers 9499 naming that same TableId. (c) A blatantly malformed 'tbl000' answers the SAME message with only the echoed value changed — so the POST validator rejects a well-formed, server-issued id exactly as it rejects garbage. Conclusion: the fault is in the POST route's parameter validation server-side; there is no request shape in the library to correct.
_disposable: one; deleted in the harness finally, ledger last_code 0, deleted:true
